issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double, but the solution implementation defines getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning int and uses integer division. This conflicts with the specified return type and will cause loss of fractional students per tutor and fail expectations where a double is required by the exercise/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature in the solution (and ensure the template/tests expect) to return double: public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). Compute using floating-point division, e.g. return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); so the result matches the UML and avoids integer truncation.
